issues.description: generate-stories requires an existing story manifest before generation, so the documented bootstrap path fails on a fresh repo.
README advertises make demo / generate-stories as runnable, but the repo ships no story data and generation cannot start without a manifest.
Story-generation HTTP calls send bearer tokens to arbitrary API bases without HTTPS enforcement, timeout, retry, or response-status handling.
mean_activations can divide by zero for one-token or effectively empty inputs.
emotion_vectors silently produces NaNs if any configured emotion has no labeled examples.
pca_components does not handle zero-variance inputs and can propagate NaN explained-variance ratios.
choice_logits forces batches to at least 8, making small --batch-size values ineffective and increasing OOM risk.
Steering summaries compute means over steered/control masks without checking that both groups are non-empty.
Emotion labels are interpolated directly into output filenames, allowing invalid paths or path traversal from config-controlled labels.
Scenario summary assumes at least two emotions; one-emotion configs produce empty off-diagonal means and NaNs.
Logit-lens tokens are written into Markdown tables without escaping pipes or newlines, so model tokens can corrupt the report.
Integration tests only assert that steering moves Elo, not that movement matches the claimed direction or correlation.
README states expected preference and steering behavior that is not enforced by tests and is contradicted by checked-in tiny steering summary.
Generated packaging metadata is committed despite .gitignore excluding egg-info, creating stale build artifacts in source control.
